description: Venture 9.2.0: monthly leagues are the primary competition screen; the legacy overall ranking UI is hidden without deleting user data or XP. Includes ten divisions, All Star Kitchen training and competition with 55 questions mapped to the Book Olimpíadas de Básico — Venture, internal notifications, and initial performance optimizations. All Star results do not modify official XP. The first monthly season is planned for November 2026. Web Push with the site closed still requires backend/VAPID setup. Browser and multi-device validation is still required.
